cases.label: FLine bare dot
cases.note: DELIBERATELY RED - do not re-cut to match. moveTo is off-screen/deep here because KotlinSourceIndex.getCompletionCategoryForSymbol resolves a contested simple NAME by first match, and afield/stdlib/Functions.kt is @file:CompletionCategory("Math") while FLine.kt carries no category - so FLine.moveTo is filed under Math and rendered in a different SECTION from Graphics. close/rot/scale/copy are mis-filed the same way (Solvers/Patterns/Synthesis/Audio). lineTo/cubicTo/here collide with nothing, fall through to path inference, and are correctly Graphics - so the name lookup is worse than its own fallback. The @CommonMembers prior ranks correctly WITHIN a section (lineTo/cubicTo/here are 1/2/3) and cannot cross one. Fix the classification, then re-measure.
